content.comment_body: Hello, I have a [product_name] base module connected directly to my computer with an ethernet cable. The IP address is set to the factory default: 192.168.0.3. The first noticeable issue is that despite being connected via ethernet, both [product_name] and [product_name] do not detect any available interfaces (see attachment with empty dropdown). I'm seeking potential solutions for this problem. I have already reset my PC's network adapter settings to default and tried assigning a specific IP in the same subnet as the PLC, but neither approach worked. The second, more significant problem is that I can connect using [product_name], but cannot connect through [product_name] (see attachments). There are no configuration changes; if I am connected in [product_name] and then switch to [product_name], the connection fails. Consequently, I am unable to download my [product_name] website to the SD card on the device. Are there any known solutions for these issues? Thank you for your help.

It appears that both [product_name] applications are unable to identify your network adapter. Did you install both setups with administrator rights? Did you launch both programs as administrator? Please open your device manager and provide a screenshot of your network adapters.

Attached is a screenshot of the network adapters. Running both [product_name] applications as administrator produces the same results—no adapters are displayed in the connection windows of either program. I'm unsure if the installations were initially performed as administrator, so I can try uninstalling and reinstalling both programs with administrator privileges.
Yes. Please reinstall both programs. After reinstalling, ensure to start each with administrator privileges.

I'm fairly certain that both [product_name] applications were installed with administrator rights, but I went ahead and uninstalled and reinstalled them as administrator. The issue persists. No network interfaces are shown in either dropdown. While [product_name] connects with 192.168.0.3, [product_name] still does not connect.

analysis.insight_summary: The user faces connectivity challenges with [product_name], specifically with ethernet interfaces not being recognized, resulting in the inability to connect. In contrast, [product_name] successfully connects using identical network settings. Despite trying reinstalls and running both applications as administrator, network adapters still do not appear in either program. Consequently, the issue restricts the user's ability to proceed with web project downloads to the device.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects both [product_name] applications to identify network interfaces reliably and provide seamless connectivity to the device without requiring manual troubleshooting. They also anticipate being able to transfer projects using either program under the same setup.
